newsitem.title: CHINA: China central banker hails foreign exchange growth.
newsitem.headline: China central banker hails foreign exchange growth.

text.p: China's central bank governor Dai Xianglong has praised the growth of the country's swelling foreign exchange reserves, saying they have boosted Beijing's international status, the Financial News said on Monday.

"With the continued growth of reserves on a large scale, China's international standing and international figure has improved greatly," the newspaper quoted Dai Xianglong, governor of the People's Bank of China, as saying.
The growth had improved China's payments ability and boosted overall national strength, Dai said without elaborating.
China's foreign exchange reserves hit $105 billion at the end of 1996, up $31.5 billion from the beginning of that year, official figures show.
The People's Bank has said it expects foreign exchange reserves to swell by at least $20 billion this year.
